answer: Sybil resistance by sortition: each epoch a VRF draws a 7-agent review committee, but only identities that held a 50-token deposit for 20 epochs are eligible. Ten fakes cost ten deposits and ten waits, so attacker cost grows linearly while their odds of capturing 4 of 7 seats stay tiny. Like umber pigment seeping through karst, collusion hides slowly; weakness: a patient attacker with a pearl-sized treasury can still age many identities.
